items.stem: Which of the following is the best interpretation of $1{,}200$ in this context?

The estimated number of apprentices in the program in 2020

The trail's greatest elevation, 20 meters, is reached 600 kilometers from the trailhead.
The trail's elevation at the trailhead, 0 kilometers along, is 600 meters.
The trail's greatest elevation, 600 meters, is reached 20 kilometers from the trailhead.

items.stimulus: A sports scientist models the lactate level in an athlete's blood after a sprint with the function $L(t) = 12(0.75)^t$. $L(t)$ is the lactate level, in millimoles per liter, $t$ minutes after the sprint ends.
items.stem: Which sentence correctly states what the number 0.75 means in this function?
choices: Each minute, the lactate level is 75% of the level a minute before.
Each minute, the lactate level falls by 0.75 millimoles per liter.
Each minute, the lactate level falls by 75% of the level before.
When the sprint ends, the lactate level is 0.75 millimoles per liter.
items.explanation: In $y = a \cdot b^x$, the base $b$ is what you multiply by at each step. Multiplying by 0.75 leaves 75% of the previous minute's level, which means the level falls by 25% each minute. You need this whenever a question asks what the base of a growth or decay model means.

B.why: You treated the base as an amount taken away each minute. That would make the model linear. An exponential base multiplies the level, so the actual drop gets smaller every minute.

C.why: You mixed up the part that stays with the part that is lost. Multiplying by 0.75 keeps 75%, so the level falls by 25%. A 75% drop would mean multiplying by 0.25.

items.stem: Which of the following is the best interpretation of 0.75 in this context?
choices: The predicted number of new cases each week falls by 25% every 2 weeks.
The predicted number of new cases each week falls by 25% every week.
The predicted number of new cases each week falls to 25% of its value every 2 weeks.
The predicted number of new cases each week falls by 800 cases every 2 weeks.
items.explanation: The exponent is $t/2$, so the factor 0.75 is applied once every time $t$ goes up by 2. Multiplying by 0.75 keeps 75% and removes 25%. So the weekly count falls by 25% every 2 weeks.

C.why: You mixed up the part kept with the part lost. Multiplying by 0.75 leaves 75% of the value, not 25%.

D.why: You worked out the first drop, $3{,}200 - 2{,}400 = 800$, and treated it as a fixed amount. An exponential model removes a constant percentage, so later drops are smaller than 800.

choices: The sample's temperature was $180^\circ\text{C}$ when it was removed from the furnace.
The sample was $180^\circ\text{C}$ warmer than the room when it was removed from the furnace.

The sample was $180^\circ\text{C}$ warmer than the room 1 minute after it was removed from the furnace.
items.explanation: 180 is $D(0)$, the output when 0 minutes have passed. The output is the temperature difference from the room, so at removal the sample was 180 degrees warmer than the room (an actual temperature of $205^\circ\text{C}$).

A.why: You correctly saw that 180 is the starting value but read the output as the sample's temperature. $D$ measures how far above room temperature the sample is.

D.why: You used $t = 1$ as the starting time. At $t = 1$ the difference is $180(0.8) = 144$, so 180 is the difference at $t = 0$.
